```sql
WITH rev AS (
  SELECT SUM(oi.product_price) AS revenue
  FROM "jaffle_shop"."dev"."order_items" oi
  WHERE oi.ordered_at >= '2025-01-01' AND oi.ordered_at < '2026-01-01'
),
cost AS (
  SELECT SUM(o.order_cost) AS cost
  FROM "jaffle_shop"."dev"."orders" o
  WHERE o.ordered_at >= '2025-01-01' AND o.ordered_at < '2026-01-01'
)
SELECT
  rev.revenue - cost.cost AS gross_profit_2025,
  (rev.revenue - cost.cost) / rev.revenue AS gross_margin_pct_2025
FROM rev, cost;
```
